name: Carrie S. Long
occupation: Former Sublette County clerk (won the November 2022 general election; vacancy declared effective June 24, 2025)
prior_offices: Sublette County clerk (won the November 2022 general election; served until a vacancy effective June 24, 2025)
background: Carrie S. Long served as Sublette County clerk after winning the November 2022 general election. A June 27, 2025, Pinedale Online notice from the Sublette County Republican Party, listing her as Carrie L. Long, stated that the Board of County Commissioners had declared a vacancy in the office of county clerk effective June 24, 2025, after her resignation. Official July 14, 2025, commissioners proceedings record the appointment of Jessica Rice as interim clerk.
